cases.prompt: Purchase order lines grid for our WPF ERP client; clerks enter 200 lines a day with the keyboard
cases.note: 2026-09-09 torture test p3-erp-desktop-dotnet: a clear UI request with one UI term (grid) and a UI framework word (WPF) was reported AMBIGUOUS because stack words carried no activation weight. Fixed: a stack word breaks the tie toward UI only when a UI term is present and no non-UI term is (tailwind-purge and similar tooling prompts stay non-activating).
